name: Anetori ~Okute na Ane wa, Eros na Ore no Seidorei~
original_name: アネトリ～オクテな姉は、エロスな俺の性奴隷～
source:
"I'll never belong to anyone else. Even if I have a boyfriend..." 

My older sister Mayu. 
We were always together. 
My love for her grew into something 
possessive, jealous. A lover's love. 

I couldn't just tell her my feelings. But one day 
her classmate confessed his feelings for her. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083726.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“我绝不会属于其他人。就算我有男朋友……”

我的姐姐真由。
我们一直形影不离。
我对她的爱逐渐变成了
占有与嫉妒，一种恋人的爱。

我无法直接告诉她自己的心意。可是有一天，
她的同班同学向她告白了。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083726.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
